column7: Template render during a permission-lookup outage (every ResolveUserPermissionAt fails): a caller without global secrets.read gets the identical 503 (status, Retry-After, body) for a missing and for an existing-but-unreadable reference, so the outage answer is no existence oracle. Guards item 1: its fault happens only for a secret that exists, so answering it with the generic storage 503 would have differed from the probe-outage 503 a missing reference gets. Green at base by design (anti-regression guard, not a red fix). CORE-FAULT-TAILS-1 item 2 (SUPERFAN-1106 leftover for #3948).
